name: Yongjin Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Yongjin Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of cold-rolled stainless-steel strips in China. The company offers titanium alloy materials, new energy battery shell materials, metal laminate composite materials; and stainless-steel water pipes. Its stainless-steel products are widely used in electronics, home appliances, kitchen appliances, daily necessities, building decoration, machinery and equipment, chemical pipelines, automobiles, elevators, and other fields.
